facts.statement: Rio Cloud Jumps returned; members can visit him every day to collect coins from the Cloud World. He is on the mountain above the Royal Vault in Freistatte.
facts.quote: Mitglieder können ihn jeden Tag besuchen und Münzen von der Wolkenwelt abholen.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quoi de neuf ? (Aktualisierungsbemerkungen vom 22. Juli)
article_summaries.summary: A German-language SOE patch-notes highlights post (on a French-titled page) for the 22 July update. It lists new pet monkeys sold in the Marketplace, a saber-tooth tiger mount, the return of the members' daily Cloud Jumps activity (Rio) that gives coins, new coin-shop housing items, and a fix letting players teleport into the Thornheart Palace without falling through the floor.
